shortDescription: Module for setup of AnalyticsProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: apdex_response_threshold
options.description: If a client receives an http response in less than the satisfactory latency threshold, the request is considered satisfied. It is considered tolerated if it is not satisfied and less than tolerated latency factor multiplied by the satisfactory latency threshold. Greater than this number and the client's request is considered frustrated. Allowed values are 1-30000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 500.

options.name: apdex_response_tolerated_factor
options.description: Client tolerated response latency factor. Client must receive a response within this factor times the satisfactory threshold (apdex_response_threshold) to be considered tolerated. Allowed values are 1-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_rtt_threshold
options.description: Satisfactory client to avi round trip time(rtt). Allowed values are 1-2000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 250.

options.name: apdex_rtt_tolerated_factor
options.description: Tolerated client to avi round trip time(rtt) factor. It is a multiple of apdex_rtt_tolerated_factor. Allowed values are 1-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_rum_threshold
options.description: If a client is able to load a page in less than the satisfactory latency threshold, the pageload is considered satisfied. It is considered tolerated if it is greater than satisfied but less than the tolerated latency multiplied by satisfied latency. Greater than this number and the client's request is considered frustrated. A pageload includes the time for dns lookup, download of all http objects, and page render time. Allowed values are 1-30000. Default value when not specified in API or module

options.name: apdex_rum_tolerated_factor
options.description: Virtual service threshold factor for tolerated page load time (plt) as multiple of apdex_rum_threshold. Allowed values are 1-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_server_response_threshold
options.description: A server http response is considered satisfied if latency is less than the satisfactory latency threshold. The response is considered tolerated when it is greater than satisfied but less than the tolerated latency factor * s_latency. Greater than this number and the server response is considered frustrated. Allowed values are 1-30000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 400.

options.name: apdex_server_response_tolerated_factor
options.description: Server tolerated response latency factor. Servermust response within this factor times the satisfactory threshold (apdex_server_response_threshold) to be considered tolerated. Allowed values are 1-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_server_rtt_threshold
options.description: Satisfactory client to avi round trip time(rtt). Allowed values are 1-2000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 125.

options.name: apdex_server_rtt_tolerated_factor
options.description: Tolerated client to avi round trip time(rtt) factor. It is a multiple of apdex_rtt_tolerated_factor. Allowed values are 1-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: client_log_config
options.description: Configure which logs are sent to the avi controller from ses and how they are processed.

options.name: client_log_streaming_config
options.description: Configure to stream logs to an external server. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: conn_lossy_ooo_threshold
options.description: A connection between client and avi is considered lossy when more than this percentage of out of order packets are received. Allowed values are 1-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_lossy_timeo_rexmt_threshold
options.description: A connection between client and avi is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted due to timeout. Allowed values are 1-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: conn_lossy_total_rexmt_threshold
options.description: A connection between client and avi is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted. Allowed values are 1-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_lossy_zero_win_size_event_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Lossy Zero Win Size Event Threshold
options.description: A client connection is considered lossy when percentage of times a packet could not be transmitted due to tcp zero window is above this threshold. Allowed values are 0-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_ooo_threshold
options.description: A connection between avi and server is considered lossy when more than this percentage of out of order packets are received. Allowed values are 1-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_timeo_rexmt_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Server Lossy Timeo Rexmt Threshold
options.description: A connection between avi and server is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted due to timeout. Allowed values are 1-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_total_rexmt_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Server Lossy Total Rexmt Threshold
options.description: A connection between avi and server is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted. Allowed values are 1-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_zero_win_size_event_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Server Lossy Zero Win Size Event Threshold
options.description: A server connection is considered lossy when percentage of times a packet could not be transmitted due to tcp zero window is above this threshold. Allowed values are 0-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: disable_ondemand_metrics
options.description: Virtual service (vs) metrics are processed only when there is live data traffic on the vs. In case, vs is idle for a period of time as specified by ondemand_metrics_idle_timeout then metrics processing is suspended for that vs. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: disable_se_analytics
options.description: Disable node (service engine) level analytics forvs metrics. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: disable_server_analytics
options.description: Disable analytics on backend servers. This may be desired in container environment when there are large number of ephemeral servers. Additionally, no healthscore of servers is computed when server analytics is disabled. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: disable_vs_analytics
options.description: Disable virtualservice (frontend) analytics. This flag disables metrics and healthscore for virtualservice. Field introduced in 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_advanced_analytics
options.description: Enables advanced analytics features like anomaly detection. If set to false, anomaly computation (and associated rules/events) for vs, pool and server metrics will be disabled. However, setting it to false reduces cpu and memory requirements for analytics subsystem. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: exclude_client_close_before_request_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Client Close Before Request As Error
options.description: Exclude client closed connection before an http request could be completed from being classified as an error. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_dns_policy_drop_as_significant
options.displayName: Exclude Dns Policy Drop As Significant
options.description: Exclude dns policy drops from the list of errors. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_gs_down_as_error
options.description: Exclude queries to gslb services that are operationally down from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_http_error_codes
options.description: List of http status codes to be excluded from being classified as an error. Error connections or responses impacts health score, are included as significant logs, and may be classified as part of a dos attack.

options.name: exclude_invalid_dns_domain_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Invalid Dns Domain As Error
options.description: Exclude dns queries to domains outside the domains configured in the dns application profile from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_invalid_dns_query_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Invalid Dns Query As Error
options.description: Exclude invalid dns queries from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_no_dns_record_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude No Dns Record As Error
options.description: Exclude queries to domains that did not have configured services/records from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_no_valid_gs_member_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude No Valid Gs Member As Error
options.description: Exclude queries to gslb services that have no available members from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_persistence_change_as_error
options.description: Exclude persistence server changed while load balancing' from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_server_dns_error_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Server Dns Error As Error
options.description: Exclude server dns error response from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_server_tcp_reset_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Server Tcp Reset As Error
options.description: Exclude server tcp reset from errors. It is common for applications like ms exchange. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_sip_error_codes
options.description: List of sip status codes to be excluded from being classified as an error. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1.

options.name: exclude_syn_retransmit_as_error
options.description: Exclude 'server unanswered syns' from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_tcp_reset_as_error
options.description: Exclude tcp resets by client from the list of potential errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_unsupported_dns_query_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Unsupported Dns Query As Error
options.description: Exclude unsupported dns queries from the list of errors. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: healthscore_max_server_limit
options.description: Skips health score computation of pool servers when number of servers in a pool is more than this setting. Allowed values are 0-5000. Special values are 0- 'server health score is disabled'. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.4. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: hs_event_throttle_window
options.description: Time window (in secs) within which only unique health change events should occur. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1209600.

options.name: hs_max_anomaly_penalty
options.description: Maximum penalty that may be deducted from health score for anomalies. Allowed values are 0-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: hs_max_resources_penalty
options.description: Maximum penalty that may be deducted from health score for high resource utilization. Allowed values are 0-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 25.

options.name: hs_max_security_penalty
options.description: Maximum penalty that may be deducted from health score based on security assessment. Allowed values are 0-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 100.

options.name: hs_min_dos_rate
options.description: Dos connection rate below which the dos security assessment will not kick in. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1000.

options.name: hs_performance_boost
options.description: Adds free performance score credits to health score. It can be used for compensating health score for known slow applications. Allowed values are 0-100. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: hs_pscore_traffic_threshold_l4_client
options.displayName: Hs Pscore Traffic Threshold L4 Client
options.description: Threshold number of connections in 5min, below which apdexr, apdexc, rum_apdex, and other network quality metrics are not computed. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.0.

options.name: hs_pscore_traffic_threshold_l4_server
options.displayName: Hs Pscore Traffic Threshold L4 Server
options.description: Threshold number of connections in 5min, below which apdexr, apdexc, rum_apdex, and other network quality metrics are not computed. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.0.

options.name: hs_security_certscore_expired
options.description: Score assigned when the certificate has expired. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.0.

options.name: hs_security_certscore_gt30d
options.description: Score assigned when the certificate expires in more than 30 days. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.0.

options.name: hs_security_certscore_le07d
options.description: Score assigned when the certificate expires in less than or equal to 7 days. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.0.

options.name: hs_security_certscore_le30d
options.description: Score assigned when the certificate expires in less than or equal to 30 days. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: hs_security_chain_invalidity_penalty
options.description: Penalty for allowing certificates with invalid chain. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.0.

options.name: hs_security_cipherscore_eq000b
options.description: Score assigned when the minimum cipher strength is 0 bits. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.0.

options.name: hs_security_cipherscore_ge128b
options.description: Score assigned when the minimum cipher strength is greater than equal to 128 bits. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.0.

options.name: hs_security_cipherscore_lt128b
options.description: Score assigned when the minimum cipher strength is less than 128 bits. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 3.5.

options.name: hs_security_encalgo_score_none
options.description: Score assigned when no algorithm is used for encryption. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.0.

options.name: hs_security_encalgo_score_rc4
options.description: Score assigned when rc4 algorithm is used for encryption. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.5.

options.name: hs_security_hsts_penalty
options.description: Penalty for not enabling hsts. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.0.

options.name: hs_security_nonpfs_penalty
options.description: Penalty for allowing non-pfs handshakes. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.0.

options.name: hs_security_selfsignedcert_penalty
options.description: Deprecated. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.0.

options.name: hs_security_ssl30_score
options.description: Score assigned when supporting ssl3.0 encryption protocol. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 3.5.

options.name: hs_security_tls10_score
options.description: Score assigned when supporting tls1.0 encryption protocol. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.0.

options.name: hs_security_tls11_score
options.description: Score assigned when supporting tls1.1 encryption protocol. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.0.

options.name: hs_security_tls12_score
options.description: Score assigned when supporting tls1.2 encryption protocol. Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.0.

options.name: hs_security_weak_signature_algo_penalty
options.displayName: Hs Security Weak Signature Algo Penalty
options.description: Penalty for allowing weak signature algorithm(s). Allowed values are 0-5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.0.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the analytics profile.

options.name: ondemand_metrics_idle_timeout
options.description: This flag sets the time duration of no live data traffic after which virtual service metrics processing is suspended. It is applicable only when disable_ondemand_metrics is set to false. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1800.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: ranges
options.description: List of http status code ranges to be excluded from being classified as an error.

options.name: resp_code_block
options.description: Block of http response codes to be excluded from being classified as an error. Enum options - AP_HTTP_RSP_4XX, AP_HTTP_RSP_5XX.

options.name: sensitive_log_profile
options.description: Rules applied to the http application log for filtering sensitive information. Field introduced in 17.2.10, 18.1.2.

options.name: sip_log_depth
options.description: Maximum number of sip messages added in logs for a sip transaction. By default, this value is 20. Allowed values are 1-1000. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the analytics profile.
